summary: End-to-end testing of Zayado V2 (header refactor single-bar, mega-menus marketplace+cockpit, app zone AppHeader on /cockpit & /diagnostic, cart/panier/checkout multi-items, diagnostic 16Q flow, leads API). Backend: 11/11 pytest passing (/api/leads demo mode + Mongo persistence; /api/checkout simule mode with correct catalogue prices incl. fauteuil×2+mug=716€; unknown product → 400; orders endpoint; webhook). Frontend: all critical flows pass (desktop header 1440 with Marketplace+Cockpit mega-menus, 8 rays, 6 modules, 5 tarifs incl. Entreprise + Mollie note; Mon compte external link to app.zayado.net/compte; app-header navy on /cockpit (CTA 'Faire le diagnostic' → /marketplace) and /diagnostic (CTA 'Explorer la marketplace'); cart flow 2 items → badge 2 → /panier total 367€ → /checkout?items=fauteuil,mug → form submit → /paiement/succes → cart emptied; diagnostic 16Q flow with email submission reaches result with radar + pro/perso; mobile drawer opens with all sections; no horizontal overflow on /, /cockpit, /diagnostic, /marketplace, /panier). Journal newsletter lead stored in Mongo with source=journal-newsletter + confirmation shown (no old 'rien n'est envoyé' text). Found and FIXED 1 CRITICAL bug: Checkout.jsx was missing Minus/Plus lucide imports causing error-boundary crash on any multi-item checkout render.

ui_bugs.issue: Button 'Mon compte' is visible in the mobile 390 header alongside wordmark/cart/hamburger. Spec says mobile header should only contain wordmark + cart + hamburger (Mon compte should live inside the drawer only).

action_items: LOW: Hide 'Mon compte' button on mobile viewport (<lg) in Nav.jsx — add 'hidden lg:inline-flex' (or similar) to [data-testid="nav-compte"] so mobile header stays wordmark + cart + hamburger as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Checkout.jsx imported only {ArrowRight, ShieldCheck} from lucide-react but used <Minus/> and <Plus/> in the summary quantity controls, causing a ReferenceError and the ErrorBoundary 'Oups' page whenever any item was present. Added Minus and Plus to the import. Verified the full checkout → payment-success flow works after the fix.
Nav.jsx mobile markup: 'Mon compte' button lacks responsive hidden class (visible on 390 — minor spec deviation).
Checkout.jsx: errors from apiPost are silently swallowed into demo success flow (catch {}) — fine for demo mode but should surface real backend failures in the future (log at minimum).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical flows pass after fix; only minor mobile-header spec deviation

seed_data_creation: Test leads created in Mongo during flow (test_journal@example.com, test_diag@example.com). Test orders created and deleted by pytest cleanup. Cart localStorage cleared during browser tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend demo/simule modes verified: POST /api/leads returns {ok:true, mode:'demo'} and stores to db.leads (upsert by email). POST /api/checkout returns {mode:'simule', ref:'ZYD-XXXXXX', total} with server-side CATALOGUE_PRIX matching data/content.js. Fauteuil=349, mug=18, box-hiver=79, box-ete=89, etc. Unknown product → 400. Order status endpoint rejects invalid ObjectId (400) and missing (404). Webhook rejects non-tr_ ids (400). Frontend: Checkout.jsx Minus/Plus bug has been fixed in this iteration. Mobile 'Mon compte' button in header still shows (spec says drawer-only) — one-line Tailwind fix. All data-testid attributes present and reliable. The diagnostic flow does send a lead to /api/leads on email submit (source='diagnostic').
rca of the issue: Checkout render crash RCA: Checkout.jsx used <Minus size={13}/> and <Plus size={13}/> but the import statement only listed {ArrowRight, ShieldCheck} from lucide-react. React threw a ReferenceError which bubbled up to the application-level ErrorBoundary, replacing the entire page with 'Oups. Une erreur est survenue.' Reproduction: /checkout?items=mug (or any id present in catalogue) → crash. Fix: added Minus, Plus to the lucide-react import. Verified: full flow /marketplace → buy → /checkout → form submit → /paiement/succes → cart emptied.
